- When two objects move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds.
- Time taken for two moving objects to completely pass each other is the combined length of both objects divided by their relative speed.
- The speed of each train can be calculated using the formula speed = length / time.
- To find the time taken for the trains to cross each other, use the combined length (sum of lengths of both trains) and their relative speed (sum of individual speeds).
